abstract: Tier-3 average treatment effects for the Silicon Sample Benchmark. This entry does not simulate respondents. For each of the 13 outcomes, one local open-weights model reads all 16 intervention texts in a single listwise prompt and forecasts the average treatment effect of each one against control. 13 prompts x 8 draws = 104 calls. Model Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B, run locally with vLLM. Results are exploratory: the configuration was selected after an unregistered search.
approach_family: direct effect forecast, not a per-respondent simulation; a single local open-weights model is prompted once per OUTCOME and returns, in one listwise response, the ATE of all 16 interventions for that outcome; the 16 stimulus texts and the codebook item wording and scales are given in the prompt; zero-shot; no persona pool, no synthetic respondents, no second model
